notes:
A signed proposal is the contract.

- **When a job is marked Won, the contract is what the customer signed.** If
  the proposal covered only some groups (say Framing and Drywall but not
  Paint), only those groups are in the contract sum, the job's budget and the
  schedule. The rest stays in the takeoff marked **unsold**, ready to sell
  later as a change order.
- A change order starts from the signed contract, not the whole bid.
- Money spent on an unsold group still shows up in job costing, since spending
  is proof the work happened.
- Until a job is Won, and whenever the proposal covers everything, the contract
  is the whole bid, as before.
- The AI tools report the same contract and budget as the app.
